title: Calendar
description: A calendar which is a container for events.

id.description: The unique identifier for the calendar.

color.description: Specifies the color theme for the calendar.

changeKey.description: Identifies the version of the calendar object.

canEdit.description: Whether the user can write to the calendar.

canShare.description: Whether the user has permission to share the calendar.

canViewPrivateItems.description: Whether the user can read calendar items marked as private.

isDefaultCalendar.description: Whether this is the default calendar.

hexColor.description: The calendar color expressed in hex format of three six-digit values.

isRemovable.description: Whether the calendar can be deleted from the user's mailbox.

isTallyingResponses.description: Whether the calendar supports tracking of meeting responses.

allowedOnlineMeetingProviders.description: The online meeting service providers available for events in this calendar.

defaultOnlineMeetingProvider.description: The default online meeting provider for meetings sent from this calendar.
